note: Board density ranges in g/cm3 (caliper in um = gsm / density). Gate 1 decision D2: SBS and CRB only until Pack Legacy supplier spec sheets arrive; CUK, kraft and greyboard are hidden. verifiedOn stays null until a mill sheet is read.

sbs.name: SBS (C1S or C2S)
sbs.source: SBS density range: build plan mill calibration (10 pt = 218, 12 pt = 256, 14 pt = 299 gsm, i.e. 0.84); Packwire packaging board chart (0.87); Ovanle bulk 1.33 cm3/g (0.75)

crb.name: CRB (coated recycled board)
crb.source: CRB density range computed from a WestRock (RockTenn) CRB caliper and basis weight chart reproduced by Itempak (0.016 in = 69 lb/1,000 sq ft; 0.024 in = 96 lb)
